translation: White emission is white matter that spreads and overflows, like the form of semen; in men it descends with urination, in women it descends continuously. All are treated as damp-heat, by the same method as treating dysentery. Red and white dysentery is pathogenic heat transmitted to the large intestine; red and white vaginal discharge is pathogenic heat transmitted to the small intestine. Later generations all take red as heat and white as cold, an error that has flowed for a thousand years; this is a mistake of physicians. He also said: The Zisheng Classic records a woman suffering red and white vaginal discharge; someone moxaed Qihai for her without effect. The next day he moxaed the Daimai point, and a ghost attached to her ear said: Yesterday's moxa was also good, only it did not hit me; now you have hit me, I am leaving. You may prepare wine and food to sacrifice to me.
